name: Balasana
description: A deeply restorative resting posture. Balasana stretches the lower back and hips while calming the mind and nervous system.
benefits: Gently stretches hips, thighs, and ankles
Calms the brain and helps relieve stress

steps.instruction: Sit comfortably back on your heels with an upright spine.
steps.voice_prompt: Sit comfortably back on your heels, lengthening your spine upward.

steps.instruction: Move forward slowly into a tabletop position.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale and move forward slowly, bringing your body into a tabletop position.

steps.instruction: Exhale and slowly lower your hips back onto your heels.
steps.voice_prompt: Exhale and lower your hips back toward your heels slowly.

steps.instruction: Keep knees together, or spread them slightly apart for comfort.
steps.voice_prompt: Bring your knees together, or spread them slightly apart to find comfort.

steps.instruction: Extend your arms overhead with palms flat on the floor.
steps.voice_prompt: Extend your arms straight out in front of you, placing your palms on the floor.

steps.instruction: Lower your chest down and rest your forehead on the mat.
steps.voice_prompt: Lay your chest down between your thighs, resting your forehead flat on the mat.

steps.instruction: Relax your shoulders and take slow, steady breaths.
steps.voice_prompt: Relax your shoulders, elbows, and back, breathing deeply.

steps.instruction: Exhale, letting your belly sink and relax against your thighs.
steps.voice_prompt: Exhale slowly, letting your belly sink and release tension against your thighs.

steps.instruction: Rest in this restorative position, taking slow breaths.
steps.voice_prompt: Rest here. Focus on the gentle expansion of your back on every inhale.

steps.instruction: Place palms under shoulders, inhale, and slowly lift back to sitting.
steps.voice_prompt: To release, place your hands under shoulders, inhale, and slowly roll up to seated.
